summary: Our Bond, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose mechanics of a previously approved one-for-twenty reverse stock split, following its October 1, 2026 board authorization. Each twenty outstanding shares combine into one; authorized shares are proportionately reduced; fractional shares round up. The split becomes market-effective at open on October 19, 2026. Current outstanding is 32,576,598 shares, falling to roughly 1,628,830 post-split. CEO Doron Kempel signed the report. This is a routine corporate action with no deal, stake, price, or board recommendation; watch for Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance implications and any post-split capital-raising.
